g.text: Latency: time to first token, then tokens per second
a 500-token answer at 50 tokens/s takes about 10 s
the user sees nothing until the end
first token at 0.8 s: time to first token (TTFT)
then about 50 tokens every second (tokens per second)
streaming does not shorten the 10 s; it moves the first visible word to 0.8 s
reasoning ("thinking") models add a hidden delay before the first visible token
